definitions: A mechanism, typically consisting of rings pivoted at right angles, for keeping an instrument such as a compass or chronometer horizontal in a moving vessel or aircraft.

A device that allows rotation of an object about a single axis. A set of three gimbals, one for each of the three dimensions, is often used to allow a camera or other device to remain level regardless of the motion of the vehicle it is mounted on.
examples: The ship's compass was mounted on a gimbal.
Modern drones often use a three-axis gimbal for stable video.
He adjusted the gimbal to get a smoother shot.
